# Insta Solver — Core Module Implementation Spec

**Generated by:** `/interviewcodebase` PHASE 3 (4-round interview, 2026-05-04)
**Companion to:** `docs/INSTASOLVER-MODULE-SPEC.md` (the strategic /myjkkn-chain output)
**This spec scope:** Implementation-detail decisions informed by codebase exploration
**Branch:** `feat/instasolver-core-module-spec`

---

## Problem Statement

**Today** — `instasolver.jkkn.ac.in` is a standalone subdomain serving as JKKN's "Issue & Requirement Tracking System" across 8 institutions. Filers log in separately. Status is kept in an external system. The MyJKKN tile at `/applications/d62fa73b-2809-4715-bfaa-f25abe3ab856` opens it in a new tab via `target=_blank`.

**Hidden truth surfaced via codebase sweep** — MyJKKN already has the substrate to fully absorb Insta Solver:
- `grievance_tickets` (39 cols, full SLA + ICC + anonymous + escalation, shipped via PRs #305/#389/#507/#608, **0 production rows** — the substrate is empty, never used at scale)
- `RaisedByType` enum already supports learner / parent / staff / alumni — audience-agnostic out of the box
- B2A external API gateway pattern (26 endpoints across 10 modules) ready to extend
- Wave B.1/B.2 config-driven notification substrate (`notification_generator_config`, 8 generators) ready to extend
- `lc_polls` voting substrate (Learners' Council polls) — perfect template for `requirement_votes`

**Core problem this spec solves:** Bridge the gap between "external subdomain that users log into separately" and "core MyJKKN module" by **promoting** the existing grievance_tickets substrate from a NAAC-gated route to a top-level `/issues` route, **migrating** the live subdomain data, **adding** the missing Requirements concept (institutional feature requests with voting + budget — distinct from grievances and from existing service_requests), and **shipping** the deferred grievance gaps (file uploads, anonymous status check, ICC RLS gating).

---

## User Stories

### Filers

- **As a learner**, I want to file an issue or feature request via MyJKKN's main nav (no separate subdomain login), so I don't context-switch.
- **As an anonymous filer** of a sensitive complaint (e.g., harassment / fee fraud), I want to track my ticket via a single-use token URL without disclosing identity, so I trust the system enough to file at all.
- **As a parent**, I want to file an issue on behalf of my child, so my voice counts on facility / fee / academic concerns.

### Triagers / Resolvers

- **As an HOD**, I want to see only my department's issues by default and approve Requirements within my budget authority (≤₹10k by default — configurable), so I'm not flooded with platform-wide noise.
- **As an ICC member**, I want to see ICC-only tickets (sexual harassment, harassment) that are invisible to other staff, so confidentiality is preserved.
- **As a faculty member**, I want to file feature Requirements (curriculum / lab equipment) and vote on others, so my professional input shapes institutional priorities.

### Oversight

- **As a super_admin**, I want to break-glass into any ticket including ICC-only with full audit trail, so I can resolve cross-cutting cases without pretending I can't see them.
- **As a Director**, I want to see the cross-institution adoption metric (`institutions_with_min_5_tickets`) on day 90 to verdict the locked initiative.

### External Integrations

- **As an external AI agent / mobile app**, I want to query issues + requirements via `/api/b2a/issues/*` and `/api/b2a/requirements/*` using a `jkkn_b2a_*` API key, so I can build agent workflows on JKKN data.

## Technical Constraints (informed by codebase exploration)

### Codebase patterns to clone

| Concern | Pattern source | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Service-layer shape | `lib/services/grievance/grievance-service.ts` (static class methods, throws on errors, singleton supabase client) | Matches existing convention; new `lib/services/issues/*` services follow this shape |
| Approval chain at apply-time | `lib/services/hr/leave-service.ts` (`buildApprovalChain` snapshots `hr_approval_flows` into the request row) | Proven pattern; clone for Requirement approval chain |
| Voting substrate | `lc_polls` (16 cols) + `lc_poll_votes` (5 cols) + `lc_poll_options` (5 cols) | Same audience (learners + staff at JKKN); proven pattern |
| Eligibility config | `referral_category_eligibility` (6 cols) | Per-category rule rows, exactly what `requirement_voting_config` needs |
| SLA business-day calculation | `fn_business_day_sla_deadline` (PR #389) | Already handles JKKN business hours + holidays; reuse, don't reimplement |
| Audit history | `grievance_history` (7 cols) | Clone shape for `requirement_history` |
| Settings CRUD UI | `app/(routes)/admin/counselors/alert-thresholds` (per-rule threshold editor) | Direct template for `/admin/issues/sla-config` |
| Form-dialog + data-table CRUD | Extracted `components/shared/crud-master/` (PR-Q2 precursor — see below) | Q2 third-copy violation |
| B2A endpoint envelope | `app/api/b2a/grievance/route.ts` (auth via `authenticateApiKey`, response shape `{success, data}`) | Mirror exactly for /api/b2a/issues/* |
| Notification generator | `unresolved_grievance` PL/pgSQL fn at `supabase/setup/02_functions.sql:10479-10571` | Rename + extend filter by `issue_type` |
| RLS policies | `supabase/migrations/20260423_unification_crud_retrofit.sql` (uses `role_has_institution_access` helper) | Clone helper-call pattern |
| `applications` table click-through | `app/(routes)/applications/[id]/page.tsx:241-250` (plain Link target=_blank) | Soft-delete row; no SSO logic to migrate (per agent finding) |

### Codebase patterns to diverge from

| Pattern | Why divert | New choice |
|---|---|---|
| Existing grievance form: raw `useState` + native HTML, no Zod | Inconsistent with most other modules (admission, leave, hostel use RHF+Zod) | Use RHF + Zod for `/issues/*` filing forms (R1.4) |
| MCP tool misnaming (`myjkkn_query_grievance` queries `service_requests`) | Bug, not pattern | Fix: split into 3 correctly-named tools as part of B.1 |
| Notification generator monolith (one `unresolved_grievance` per concern) | We could do per-issue-type, but config-row-driven approach extends cleaner | Single `unresolved_issue` filtering by `issue_type` (R3.2) |
| `applications.url` pointing at external subdomain | Subdomain is being absorbed | Soft-delete row entirely once /issues is in main nav (R3.3) |

### Hard constraints

| Constraint | Source | Implication |
|---|---|---|
| `pgcrypto` lives in `extensions` schema, not `public` | Memory `feedback_supabase_pgcrypto_extensions_schema.md` | Any function body using `digest`/`hmac`/`gen_random_bytes` MUST schema-qualify (`extensions.gen_random_uuid()`) — relevant for `requirement_requests.id DEFAULT extensions.gen_random_uuid()` |
| Supabase JS `.gte/.lte` values are URL-encoded literals — never SQL expressions | Memory `feedback_supabase_js_gte_literal_trap.md` | Compute date cutoffs as `Date.toISOString()` in JS for B2A filters; never pass `"now() - interval '24 hours'"` as a literal |
| Vercel CLI resolves project from cwd's `.vercel/project.json` | Memory `feedback_vercel_cli_cwd_resolution.md` | Any deploy hooks / env var operations chain `cd target && cmd` in single Bash call |
| `echo` appends `\n` to piped values | Memory `feedback_echo_appends_newline_to_env_values.md` | Use `printf '%s'` for any env-var sync operations during cutover |
| `pgcrypto` digest in function bodies needs `SET search_path = public, extensions, pg_temp` if using unqualified names | Memory `feedback_supabase_pgcrypto_extensions_schema.md` | Apply to all new SQL functions in B.1 |

### Concurrency-safe build approach

- **Concurrency cap:** ≤3 parallel agents for tool-heavy DDL/code-gen work (memory `feedback_concurrent_agent_concurrency_cap_for_tool_heavy_tasks.md`)
- **Per-commit push:** any agent-driven build prompts must include the per-commit-push paragraph (memory `feedback_agent_prompts_must_push_per_commit.md`)
- **Branch naming:** avoid "main" anywhere in agent branch names — pre-push hook rejects (memory `feedback_avoid_main_in_branch_names_for_agents.md`)

## Edge Cases & Error Handling

| Scenario | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Anonymous filer loses their `anonymous_token` | No recovery (token is single-display + browser-storage saved). They re-file or contact support. NOT auto-restorable — by design. |
| Anonymous filer files duplicate ticket | System cannot dedupe (no identity). Each filing creates a new row. Triager dedupes manually. |
| ICC member loses ICC role mid-resolution | Lose access to in-progress ICC tickets immediately. Other ICC members see the ticket. Audit log records role change. |
| Super_admin breaks-glass into ICC ticket | Audit row inserted into `grievance_history` with `metadata.icc_breakglass=true`, visible to all super_admins on next ICC dashboard load. Surfaced for review. |
| Voter votes on a Requirement, then loses eligibility (e.g., switches institution) | Vote stays counted (immutable). New institution can't change their vote. New institution gives them eligibility on NEW Requirements only. |
| Requirement passes voting but never gets approved (HOD never acts) | After 30 days in `voting_closed` state with no approver action, auto-escalate to next tier per `requirement_approval_thresholds.escalate_after_days` (default 7). |
| Migration: `instasolver.jkkn.ac.in` row references a category that doesn't exist in MyJKKN | Migration script creates a "Legacy / Uncategorized" category, places ticket there, super_admin re-categorizes manually post-migration. |
| Migration: subdomain ticket has attachments stored on subdomain server | Migration script downloads attachments to local temp, uploads to Supabase `issues/attachments/`, rewrites `attachments` jsonb. Failure logs to migration audit table. |
| Subdomain stays alive past day-90 because metric < 6 | Per kill criterion: subdomain stays canonical, /issues becomes read-only mirror of subdomain data via reverse-sync. NEW lock at that point. |
| User files identical content on both subdomain (still alive in window) AND /issues route | Two rows. No dedup in v1. Triager merges manually using `legacy_external_id`. Document as known limitation. |
| File upload exceeds 5×10MB limit | Form blocks submit with inline error. Files NOT uploaded if validation fails. |
| MIME type rejected | Form rejects upload at client; if bypassed, server rejects + logs attempt. |
| `/track/<token>` token doesn't exist | Generic 404 page (don't leak whether token has ever existed — prevents enumeration attacks). |
| `/track/<token>` rate-limit attempts (someone trying many tokens) | `platform_policies.issues.anonymous_track.rate_limit_per_hour = 60` row enforces per-IP rate limit. 429 after limit. |

## Out of Scope (explicit non-goals for v1)

- Service requests (certificates, transport passes, hall tickets, auditorium bookings) — stay at `/service-requests`. Two-stream /issues only.
- `bug_reports` (Bug Boundary SDK developer bug reports) — separate concern, separate SDK, do not unify.
- `hostel_incidents` / `marathon_incidents` / `waste_incidents` — domain-specific incident reports stay where they are.
- Auto-suggestion algorithm for grievance→requirement promotion (manual-only in v1).
- Mobile app push notifications.
- Cross-institution Requirement voting (default-seeded as same-institution-only; super_admin can flip via UI but no v1 UX work).
- Email cutover comms (banners-only per R4.4).
- Per-institution staged rollout (all 8 day 0 per R4.3).
- White-labeling the /issues route per institution (single canonical surface across all 8).
- Public roadmap of approved Requirements (e.g., "what features are coming next") — could be v2 nice-to-have but not requested.
- Endorsement / upvote of Grievances (1-filer-1-ticket model preserved).
- Anonymous filing for Requirements (Grievance-only).
- SLA reporting dashboards beyond what `unresolved_grievance` (renamed to `unresolved_issue`) generator already feeds the dashboard work-item engine.
- Slash-command shortcuts for filing (e.g., from WhatsApp `/file-issue` — could be v2).

## Open Questions (carried over from /myjkkn-chain spec)

These remain open for Director input before B.1 DDL applies. They DO NOT block spec-PR open + draft, but they DO block B.1 substrate apply.

1. **8 vs 9 institutions for the metric.** INSTITUTIONS const has 9 entries (8 colleges + Nattraja Vidhyalya school). Current spec uses "8 colleges" (more conservative). Confirm or adjust.
2. **`class_rep` / `student_council` triage authority** — allowed to triage peer issues, or filer-only?
3. **Parents filing Requirements** — allowed (cafeteria/transport/hostel suggestions) or grievance-only?
4. **Subdomain ownership transfer** — Boobalan listed as support contact. Confirm he has DB-export access for M1 migration.
5. **NAAC accreditation reporting continuity** — confirm no broken NAAC report queries when `/accreditation/naac/grievance` becomes a redirect (per agent finding: trigger-driven `quality_evidence_mappings`, no URL refs — should be safe).
6. **MCP tool consumers in production** — does any external consumer currently call `myjkkn_query_grievance` (the misnamed tool)? If yes, the rename must include a deprecated-alias retention window. If no, clean swap.

## Verification Strategy

Per /interviewcodebase + chain protocol:

| Layer | Verification command |
|---|---|

## Final Interview Locks (2026-05-04 15:48 IST) — Director resolutions

All 6 open Director questions from the original spec resolved via final interview. **One lock changes the metric** (universe expanded from 8 colleges to 10 institutions, threshold revised ≥6→≥7), the other 5 confirm what was documented.

| # | Question | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| **Q1** | Metric universe (8 vs 9 vs 10 institutions) | **10 institutions (8 colleges + 2 schools), threshold ≥7/10 by 2026-08-04** ⚠️ REVISED |
| **Q2** | class_rep / student_council triage | **Filer-only** — no special peer-triage powers in v1 (existing RLS default) |
| **Q3** | Parents filing Requirements | **Allowed** for transport / hostel / cafeteria / safety / fee-policy categories only |
| **Q4** | Subdomain ownership / DB-export | **Confirmed** — Boobalan has full DB access |
| **Q5** | NAAC reporting continuity | **Ship without separate NAAC review** — agent analysis confirms redirect-safe (trigger-driven `quality_evidence_mappings`, not URL-driven) |
| **Q6** | MCP external consumers | **No external consumers** — clean swap, no deprecated alias |

### Updated metric query (replaces the simpler version in original spec)

Universe filter expanded to include schools, threshold bumped:

```sql
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE n>=5) AS hit_count
FROM (
  SELECT gt.institution_id, count(*) AS n
  FROM public.grievance_tickets gt
  JOIN public.institutions inst ON inst.id = gt.institution_id
  WHERE gt.created_at >= '2026-05-04'
    AND inst.entity_type = 'institution'
    AND inst.category IN ('ug_pg', 'pg', 'ug')   -- 8 colleges + 2 schools
    AND inst.name <> 'JKKN Testing Institution'  -- exclude test row
    AND COALESCE(inst.is_active, true) = true
  GROUP BY gt.institution_id
) sub;
-- HIT condition: hit_count >= 7
```

Per memory `feedback_implementation_pivot_vs_verdict_semantics.md` — this is a metric/threshold change, requires REVISED entry in Locked-Initiatives.md (NOT a silent edit). Verdict-date 2026-08-04 unchanged.
